At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

 Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #LifeAtBNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

 We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Cloud Operations Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our Cloud, Platform, and AI Infrastructure team. This role is located in Pittsburgh or Lake Mary.

 In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: 

 
 Support day-to-day operations across BNY’s multi-cloud environment, with a primary focus on Azure and GCP

 Provide operational support for AWS and OCI as needed

 Manage cloud provisioning, configuration changes, service requests, and decommissioning activities

 Support AKS/Kubernetes and containerized workloads in partnership with engineering teams

 Perform Linux administration and support for cloud-hosted platforms and workloads

 Support cloud-hosted database platforms including Azure SQL Managed Instance and Oracle

 Help maintain operational support for AI/ML infrastructure, model runtime environments, and ModelOps-related services

 Drive remediation of configuration, security, and vulnerability issues using tools such as Wiz and Qualys

 Monitor infrastructure and services using enterprise observability tools including Splunk

 Respond to incidents, support root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions

 Support release and deployment management, ensuring controlled and reliable production changes

 Assist with cloud demand and capacity management, including quota monitoring, forecasting, and capacity risk identification

 Partner with security, risk, compliance, audit, and engineering teams to support governance and control requirements

 Contribute to business continuity, disaster recovery, resiliency, and operational recovery practices

 Automate routine operational processes using Terraform, Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar tools

 Maintain documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures

 Participate in on-call or after-hours support rotations as needed

 
 To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: 

 
  Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. - Professional certifications in relevant technologies or infrastructure management are preferred. **EXPERIENCE:** Typically 6-10 years of experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related experience

 Experience in cloud operations, SRE, infrastructure engineering, platform support, or AI/ML platform operations

 Hands-on experience with Azure and GCP in enterprise production environments

 Working knowledge of AWS and/or OCI

 Experience supporting Kubernetes, especially AKS

 Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills

 Experience supporting cloud-hosted databases such as Azure SQL MI and/or Oracle

 Experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code

 Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as Splunk

 Experience with vulnerability remediation and support tools such as Wiz and Qualys

 Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud, infrastructure, networking, databases, and platform services

 Familiarity with scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell

 Experience with incident, problem, request, and release management in enterprise environments

 Understanding of governance, risk, compliance, and controls in a regulated environment

 Strong communication, collaboration, and operational ownership mindset
